name: vite-ssg
description: vite-ssg is a static site generation tool for Vue 3 on Vite that prerenders the routes of a Vue app to static HTML.
notes: firstRelease from npm vite-ssg creation (2020-12-21). Vue 3 prerenderer used as an SSG; Markdown is compiled to Vue components by unplugin-vue-markdown and routes are built from import.meta.glob over the posts directory. Minimal site: bare app shell, one index route.
